data.request: requested in the manuscript's revision (items 1, 2 and 5 of its analysis list)

definitions.axes: template RAS at 0.25 mm: x left->right, y posterior->anterior (the section axis), z inferior->superior
definitions.variants: demons = labels of record; sdf = signed-distance interpolation, same chain; slab = un-interpolated: each labeled section stands for its slab half-way to its neighbors (outer sections: half the adjacent gap), labeled where the pulled template point lies in the slab and inside the section's outline (nearest in-plane sample)
definitions.offsets: centroid(b) - centroid(a), world mm (pairs); brain label - SARM (item 5); left - mirrored right (item 2)
definitions.metrics: Dice; ASSD and HD95 over the pooled symmetric surface distances (surface = m & ~erosion), as lgnstn_geometry.py
definitions.abs_dy_over_section_spacing: |dy| / the median calibrated spacing of the two brains' labeled sections (blockface frame)
definitions.interpolation_shift: centroid(demons) - centroid(slab): what the interpolation between sections moves
definitions.mirror: left label vs right label mirrored x -> -x on the symmetric grid
definitions.sarm: SARM level 6 in our template (nearest-neighbor carry through the NMT v2 mapping of record), DLG for the LGN, STh for the STN, split at x = 0

reproduction.note: all 12 demons pair rows of lgnstn_geometry_current (Dice, ASSD, centroid, per-axis offsets) recomputed from the same files and asserted equal to 1e-3

mapping.label_carry: nearest neighbor (mri/code/atlas_v2.py: SARM level 6 into the template, labels for figures)
mapping.local_accuracy: not measured: the mapping's quality measures are global (brain-mask Dice, inverse consistency, outline at the brain surface); its accuracy at the LGN and STN has no measurement of its own
